note: The leaf reads 'Expauit famam' (as X has it); Y's 'Expuit famam' changes 'took fright at' to 'spat out'. Otherwise the texts are identical, and both record the catchword 'Felices tenebrae'.
The texts match apart from long-s conventions. Y misreads 'sed altero' as 'sed aftero' and invents a 'classical scene' for the woodcut initial, which actually shows two small figures, as X says.

Y drops 'ἔρον' ('ἀναπαύσιος ἔρον ἔχει'), garbles many Greek words ('ζέπηται', 'ῥέοις', 'λουζὰ', 'σεμνὰ ... ῥαχεία' for 'τρέπηται', 'νέοις', 'λουτρὰ', 'στρωμνὰ ... τραχεῖα') and has 'fit' for 'sit' in the Latin.
The leaf has page number '3292' and 'Pag. 554'; X gives '1202' and '854'. X also turns the Florentine reading 'extraneasse' and the phrase 'extraneus heres' into 'externasse' and 'externare heras'.

The leaf has the καί ligature in 'λιμέσιν καὶ' and 'Δὴ τότε καὶ', which X renders as 'ἢ'. X also drops 'καὶ' in note 123, gives 'infano' for 'insano', puts Arabic letters into the Hebrew, and adds a spurious sig '126'.

Y omits 'l' in 'semiperipheria l f d' and writes 'anguli a d deinceps ... angulis a d deinceps' where the leaf has 'ad u' and 'ad o'. It also has 'ex hypothesi' for 'ex thesi' and 'per 12 p 1' for 'per 13 p 1'.

The main text is the same, apart from X's systematic 'f' for long s ('ficco', 'effentia'). The right-hand marginal notes are cut off and survive only as fragments ('A ta re ri', 'So Ge tu cu mi'); Y marks them unclear, while X invents full notes such as 'Acre', 'Solutio.' and 'Generatio & interitus.'

The right edge of the text is cut off. Y marks the lost endings with '[...]'; X silently fills them in ('Er-/fahrung', 'Na-/hrung' where the leaf shows 'Erf...' / 'rung'). X also normalises 'niemahls' and 'Schwantz'.
The leaf's gloss reads '妻去聲下同縲力追反絏息列反', as Y has it. X replaces the fanqie readings with an invented '縲音雷絏音屑'.
Y turns 'Clā uiro' (Clam uiro) into a new speaker line 'Cl. a uiro'. It also misreads 'Neq; salsum' as 'falsum', 'inijcio' as 'inuicio' and 'sanun es' as 'sanus es'.
